title: Take-Two's own sold-in figures: Grand Theft Auto series over 470M, GTA V over 230M, Red Dead Redemption 2 more than 85M (10-Q, quarter ended 30 Jun 2026)
game: Grand Theft Auto series, Grand Theft Auto V, Red Dead Redemption 2
why: Evergreen bank piece (numbers). DATES IT: Take-Two reports Q2 FY2027 on Monday 9 Nov 2026 and files its next 10-Q after that; post before the new filing or re-check the three figures against it (GTA VI launches 19 Nov 2026).

sources.name: Take-Two Interactive Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Rockstar Games section: GTA franchise sold-in over 470 million units; GTA V over 230 million; RDR2 more than 85 million)
Take-Two press release 7 Aug 2026 (Q1 FY2027 results; defines Net Bookings as sold digitally or sold-in physically; no unit counts in it)
Take-Two press release 13 Oct 2026: Q2 FY2027 results on Monday 9 Nov 2026

first_report: Take-Two's Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026 (filed about early Aug 2026; the cover gives shares as of 27 Jul 2026), read on sec.gov 8 Nov 2026 about 10:30Z. Evergreen.
footage: Our graphics (numbers): Rockstar's own box art from rockstargames.com, closing on two official Red Dead Redemption 2 Steam store screenshots (1920x1080, no guns raised). No trailer: a Take-Two filing figure has no single footage; sources tried: Steam store assets and rockstargames.com.

claims.text: 'Grand Theft Auto franchise ... has sold-in over 470 million units worldwide'
claims.status: read in the 10-Q, Rockstar Games section

claims.text: 'Grand Theft Auto V, which was released in 2013, has sold-in over 230 million units worldwide'
Red Dead Redemption 2 'has sold-in more than 85 million units worldwide'
No Red Dead franchise total is stated in the 10-Q, so none is shown
GTA V over 230M is more than twice RDR2's 85M (230 > 170): our arithmetic on Take-Two's figures
Basis: Take-Two's own word is sold-in; its release defines Net Bookings as 'sold digitally or sold-in physically'. The Reel says sold (مباعة) and never 'shipped' or 'to players'
Outlet figures (GTA V 'nearly 230M', RDR2 87M) were seen in searches and are NOT used

gate: gate 10:40Z: 10-Q read via WebFetch (units, form type, period); press releases read; Steam page and Roblox/Epic were tried first and had no readable primary record figure (Steam stats page shows live counts only, Roblox Q3 letter claims no record, Epic news page returned 403). Exit A.
